---
title: Magic Move Timing Options
format: revealjs
revealjs-plugins:
  - magic-move
---

## Default timing (baseline for comparison)

::: magic-move

```r
a <- 1
b <- 2
d <- 4
```

```r
a <- 1
b <- 2
c <- 3
d <- 4
```

:::

## Staggered exit {.smaller}

Each deleted line fades out as a whole, one line after another; the line
below them only starts sliding up once both have finished exiting.

::: {.magic-move delay-exit=0 stagger=0.3 delay-move=1.3}

```r
a <- 1
b <- 2
c <- 3
d <- 4
```

```r
a <- 1
d <- 4
```

:::

## Delayed enter

New tokens wait until moves/exits are mostly done before fading in.

::: {.magic-move delay-enter=0.6}

```r
a <- 1
d <- 4
```

```r
a <- 1
b <- 2
c <- 3
d <- 4
```

:::

## Slower, custom-eased transition

::: {.magic-move duration=1200 easing=ease-out}

```r
a <- 1
b <- 2
```

```r
a <- 1
b <- 2
c <- 3
```

:::
